## Data Entry QC {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r libs, include = F}
library(plantcomNGPN)
library(tidyverse) # dplyr, purrr, tidyr
library(knitr) # for kable and include_graphic()
library(kableExtra) # for custom kable features
library(sf) # for checking plot coords against park bounding boxes
library(data.table) # faster summarizing than dplyr for big datasets
library(DT) # much faster at making tables for large dfs than kable

all_years <- params$all_years
year_curr <- params$year_curr
year_range <- if(all_years == TRUE){2011:year_curr} else {year_curr}
year_hist <- 2011:(year_curr - 1)

# Read in NGPN SOP Table 4 tree DBH vs DRC species list:
tab4_spp <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KateMMiller/plantcomNGPN/refs/heads/main/data/NGPN_PCM_Table_4_Tree_shrub_species_list.csv")

```

```{r imports, include = F}
importData(type = 'local',
           dbname = c("FFI_RA_AGFO", "FFI_RA_BADL", "FFI_RA_DETO", "FFI_RA_FOLA",
                      "FFI_RA_FOUS", "FFI_RA_JECA", "FFI_RA_KNRI", #"FFI_RA_MNRR",
                      "FFI_RA_MORU", "FFI_RA_SCBL", "FFI_RA_THRO", "FFI_RA_WICA"),
           keep_tables = T)
           #keep_tables = T, export_views = T, export_path = "C:/temp")
```

```{r source, include = F}
# source code to generate most of the datasets/checks that are then printed in the rmd.
source("NGPN_network_QC_checks_compile.R")
#source("./docs/NGPN_network_QC_checks_compile.R")
```

### QC Check Table {.tabset}
```{r qccheck}
QC_check_table
```

```{r macro, eval = macro_include, results = 'asis'}
cat("### MacroPlot Checks {.tabset}", "\n\n")

check_null_print(kbl_macro_miss_utm, 4, "Missing UTM")

check_null_print(kbl_out_pts_utm, 4, "Incorrect UTM")

check_null_print(kbl_datum, 4, "Datum check")

check_null_print(kbl_out_pts_dd, 4, "Incorrect DD")

check_null_print(kbl_macro_blanks, 4, "Blank Loc. Values")

check_null_print(kbl_macro_imp, 4, "Impossible Values")

check_null_print(kbl_macro_topo, 4, "UV1 Topo Positions")

check_null_print(kbl_macro_surf, 4, "UV2 Surface Water")

check_null_print(kbl_macro_hydro, 4, "UV3 Hydro Regime")

check_null_print(kbl_macro_veg, 4, "UV4 Veg. Type")

cat("\n\n")
```

```{r sampev, eval = samp_include, results = 'asis'}
cat("### Sample Event Checks {.tabset}", "\n\n")

check_null_print(kbl_miss_samp, 4, "No SampleEvents")

check_null_print(kbl_mac_samp2, 4, "MonStat Year Mismatch")

```


```{r taxa, eval = taxa_include, results = 'asis'}
cat("### Taxa Table {.tabset}", "\n\n")

check_null_print(dt_taxa_miss_sci, 4, "Blank SciName")

check_null_print(kbl_taxa_miss_sym, 4, "Blank Symbol")

check_null_print(dt_taxa_miss_tsn, 4, "Blank ITIS_TSN")

check_null_print(kbl_taxa_miss_nb, 4, "Blank NotBio")

check_null_print(dt_taxa_dup_notbio, 4, "Inconsistent NotBio")

check_null_print(dt_taxa_dup_bio, 4, "Inconsistent Species")

cat("\n\n")
```

```{r pointint, eval = pint_include, results = 'asis'}
cat("### Point Intercept {.tabset}", "\n\n")

check_null_print(dt_num_ground, 4, "Missing Ground")

check_null_print(dt_ht_check, 4, "Missing Height")

check_null_print(kbl_dup_order, 4, "Duplicate Order")

check_null_print(kbl_ht_oor, 4, "Height over 2m")

check_null_print(kbl_stat_code, 4, "Status Typos")

check_null_print(dt_stat_blank, 4, "Status Blanks")

check_null_print(dt_nb_l_stat, 4, "NotBio Live")

check_null_print(kbl_trans12, 4, "Odd Transects")

check_null_print(kbl_trans50, 4, "Transects not 50m")

#check_null_print(kbl_hit1_ht, 4, "Heights on Order != 1") # returns >8k of records

#check_null_print(kbl_nb_dm_stat, 4, "NotBio Dead") # returns >125k records

cat("\n\n")
```

```{r densb, eval = densb_include, results = 'asis'}
cat("### Nested Quadrats {.tabset}", "\n\n")

check_null_print(kbl_dtrans12, 4, "Odd Transects")

# check_null_print(kbl_trans1_10, 4, "Odd Areas") # Returns ~500 records

check_null_print(kbl_dtrans1, 4, "Transects not = 1")

check_null_print(kbl_transwid, 4, "Transect width != 1m")

check_null_print(kbl_subfrac_imp, 4, "Subfrac Typo")

check_null_print(kbl_subbelt, 4, "Subbelt Typo")

```

```{r trees, eval = tree_include, results = 'asis'}
cat("### Trees and Poles {.tabset}", "\n\n")

check_null_print(dt_trees_wrong_drc, 4, "Wrong Diam - DRC")

check_null_print(dt_trees_wrong_dbh, 4, "Wrong Diam - DBH")

check_null_print(dt_bigt, 4, "Big Trees")

cat("\n\n")

cat("#### Big Trees Diam. Distr", "\n\n")

hist(bigt$diam, main = "Distribution of DBH/DRC > 60cm", xlab = "DBH/DRC class")

cat("\n\n")
```

